name: multi_frequency_baseline_wander
mechanism: Generates a more realistic baseline wander artifact by summing multiple low-frequency sine waves with randomized frequencies, amplitudes, and phases instead of a single sine wave.
code_snippet: for _ in range(3): baseline_wander += bw_amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * bw_freq * t + bw_phase)

name: simplify_lqt1_t_wave_morphology
mechanism: Models the LQT1 T-wave as a single, symmetrical, wide Gaussian wave by removing the secondary early ST segment filling component.
code_snippet: lead_I += gaussian_wave(t, t_center, t_sigma, t_amp_I + twa_mod_I)

name: adjust_lqt2_notch_blending
mechanism: Replaced skewed Gaussian functions with standard Gaussians and reduced the temporal spacing between the two peaks to produce a more realistic blended notch in LQT2 T-waves.
code_snippet: lead_I += gaussian_wave(t, t1_center, t1_sigma, t1_amp_I + twa_mod_I)
